content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in finding out if it's possible to configure the [product_name] Communication Module using either the [product_name] Basis Module or the [product_name] Operator Device. Additionally, I'm wondering if I can change user information, such as contact numbers, with these modules. Thanks in advance.

1) No. 2) No. The [product_name] Basis Module only allows data transfer from the circuit program to the Communication Module. What you are aiming to do would require reconfiguration, which is only possible using the web management interface of the Communication Module.
Hello, Thank you for your prompt reply.

analysis.insight_summary: Users asked if they could set up and modify user details for the [product_name] Communication Module directly using the [product_name] Basis Module or Operator Device. Responses clarified that both configuration and user data changes are only possible via the web-based management platform of the Communication Module. These limitations regarding direct configuration do not fully meet user expectations for operational flexibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to configure and update details on the Communication Module, including user information, through either the [product_name] Basis Module or Operator Device interfaces.
pain_keywords: cannot change details via BM or TDE
